MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
MATCH (p)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WHERE r.tenure = 'latest'
  AND ((p.current_team <> 'Houston Rockets' AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) > 2)
       OR (t.founded_year <> '1949' AND t.championships <> '1'))
WITH DISTINCT p
RETURN p.position AS col1, SUM(CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64)) AS col2
